name: Modern Bob
description:
Modern times call for modern hairstyles.


Enjoy this unique, modern look, perfect for any occasion for you and your Dolly! This single Hunnys Closet item pairs perfectly with the Natural Hair Dyes set, also available for sale in the Hunnys Closet shop.


Owning this unlocks the following single Hunnys Closet item:

Hair Style: Modern Bob


All pieces purchased within this Hunnys Closet Shop collection will immediately unlock the specified item(s) for use in the Hunnys Closet: https://closet.hunnys.io 


As long as you currently hold this token in the same wallet that you are connected with when using the Hunnys Closet, it will automatically be available for use - enjoy!
